title: Career development in Tourism and Travel industry

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain basic terms related to tourism and travel industry
Identify career opportunities in the travel and hospitality industry
Identify the system of service providers in the tourism and travel industry
Understand the impact of IT on tourism and travel business operations
Apply CBLE method to analyze and solve problems in tourism and travel operations
Demonstrate presentation and public speaking skills
Show adaptability, integration, and continuous learning
Demonstrate self-motivation and responsibility in learning
Provide an overview of the global and Vietnamese tourism industry
Understand the characteristics and classification of human resources in tourism
Understand the VTOS standards for tourism professionals
Understand the ASEAN common competency standards for tourism professionals
Understand career pathways in the tourism and travel industry
Develop personal career plans and future career opportunities
Apply experiential learning methods in tourism studies
Organize field trips and experiential learning activities
Understand and apply CNTT applications in tourism and travel management
